label: For "Clinical Text PHI Redaction": Redact or pseudonymise PHI in clinical notes consistently so notes can be used for research and model training. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluation on synthetic or clean notes.
